title: Corporate forensic evidence taxonomy
audience: Internal investigations, regulatory defense, and law-enforcement liaison through counsel
note: Business-law and compliance map. Not a classified case file. Intercepts, SIGINT, and live NCIC queries are out of scope.

categories.label: Business Records
categories.application: Governance documents, board minutes, vendor contracts, and operational logs offered under FRE 803(6) as records of a regularly conducted activity.
categories.corporateUse: Privilege review, then produce regularly kept records the company actually maintains. Do not invent logs.

bindings.detail: documented local command — run against this studio, not a government portal

categories.label: Financial Records / Accounting Evidence
categories.application: Audit trails, ledger extracts, wire authorizations, PAC disbursements, and BSA/AML SAR/CTR filing obligations the company already has or must file.
categories.corporateUse: Preserve bank and ERP exports. SAR is a filing duty for the institution, not a query this studio runs. OFAC/EDGAR/FINRA are public REST stubs when keys exist.

categories.label: Mobile Device Evidence
categories.application: BYOD, MDM exports, and device inventories the company already has. Fourth Amendment analysis if government collection is in play (Carpenter).
categories.corporateUse: Use MDM and asset lists. Do not query IMEI/IMSI databases or run live location. Carpenter is doctrine for counsel, not a tracker.

categories.label: Removable Media / Portable Storage
categories.application: USB/SD as exfiltration vectors. Chain of custody and DLP alerts the company already generated.
categories.corporateUse: Hash and bag media the company seized under policy. Closest installed static tools are hachoir/pefile when inventory install ran. No live disk imager in the npm lockfile.

categories.corporateUse: Prefer hashes the company computed. AIP-Σ0 SHA-256 receipts cover local tool output. hash-wasm/ssri appear only if inventory install added them — they are not in package-lock.json.

enforcement.label: Cyber intrusion / CFAA
enforcement.framework: 18 U.S.C. § 1030(a)(5) — unauthorized damage to protected computers
enforcement.corporateResponse: Preserve logs and forensic images. Counsel decides CISA notice if the system is in scope. This app does not probe or exploit hosts.

enforcement.label: Sabotage / infrastructure / food-supply tampering
enforcement.corporateResponse: Recall and regulator notice through operations counsel. Insurance notice. Not a field-collection kit.

enforcement.label: Money laundering / BSA
enforcement.corporateResponse: If the company is a financial institution, counsel calendars SAR. Freeze and preserve. Lyra does not file SARs.

enforcement.label: FCPA
enforcement.corporateResponse: Internal investigation and voluntary-disclosure analysis. No DOJ portal from this process.

enforcement.label: Campaign finance / PAC
enforcement.corporateResponse: Segregate PAC funds and FEC reporting through election counsel. Do not invent contribution facts.

enforcement.label: Export controls / ITAR
enforcement.corporateResponse: Commodity jurisdiction and voluntary disclosure via export counsel. No DDTC login here.

enforcement.label: Insider threat / trade secrets
enforcement.corporateResponse: Preserve devices and access logs. NISPOM/DCSA only if the company is already in that regime.

enforcement.label: Racketeering (RICO)
enforcement.corporateResponse: Civil RICO exposure memo. Pattern facts must come from the brief. Do not mint a conspiracy.

workflow.title: Legal hold
workflow.action: Issue a hold on email, chat, BMS/ERP exports, and financials the company controls.

workflow.title: Forensic imaging
workflow.action: Bit-for-bit copies of company servers and devices. Closest local tools are inventory hachoir/pefile — not a live imager.

workflow.title: Chain of custody
workflow.action: Tag and log each item. Hashes via AIP-Σ0 receipts for local tool output.

workflow.title: Privilege review
workflow.action: Segregate attorney-client communications before production. FRE 501 is the local privilege reminder.

workflow.title: Regulatory notice
workflow.action: Counsel decides SAR, CISA, SEC, FEC triggers. Placeholders only in .env.example.

workflow.title: Law-enforcement liaison
workflow.action: Coordinate through outside counsel. This studio is not a CJIS interface; NCIC stays 403.

workflow.title: Insurance / continuity
workflow.action: D&O, cyber, and interruption notices are business process, not an API here.

workflow.title: Remediation
workflow.action: Patch, revoke credentials, vendor risk. Cloudflare wrangler remains dry-run only.

wontDo.title: SIGINT, VoIP intercepts, WeChat decrypt, SDR/FPGA/broadcast subcarriers
wontDo.reason: Not a collection platform. Treat only records the company already lawfully holds.

wontDo.title: Live IMEI/IMSI or handset triangulation
wontDo.reason: No carrier interface. Carpenter is doctrine, not a tracker.

wontDo.title: Cuckoo live malware sandbox
wontDo.reason: Source may be cloned. Sandbox never started.

wontDo.title: Live SWIFT / correspondent banking session
wontDo.reason: No bank gateway. Use copies the bank already produced.
